name: doc-gardening-session
details:
Session-focused plan for Development Documentation gardening.

Based on deep code immersion, identified specific issues to fix:

**ARCHITECTURE.md Issues:**
- File structure section outdated (mentions path-security.ts, missing checksums.ts/formatting.ts)
- Test counts outdated (says 85 tests, we have 166)
- Dependencies section wrong (mentions proper-lockfile, we use @esfx/async-readerwriterlock)
- "Not Yet Tested" section claims multi-process not tested (but we have integration tests!)

**docs/ Organization:**
- LOCKING-REDESIGN.md is historical design doc - should it be in docs/archive/?
- Reference docs (MCP-SDK-README.md, 039-Memory-tool.md) are fine as-is
- USAGE.md is great!

**CONTRIBUTING.md:**
- Verify it adequately covers development workflow
- Check if needs section on code organization/architecture

Session goal: Polish existing dev docs to reflect actual codebase accurately
